{{sbc|Void Shift:}} '''Malzahar''' gains {{tip|Cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and 90% damage reduction. |description2= ''Void Shift's'' {{sti|cooldown}} refreshes whenever '''Malzahar''' takes non-{{tip|minion}} damage or is affected by a {{tip|crowd control}} effect, and resets upon [[death|respawning]]. |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |static = {{pp|30;24;18;12|1;6;11;16}} |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * ''Void Shift'' will not resist allied {{tip|crowd control}} nor will it be deactivated by them. * ''Void Shift'' will not mitigate {{tip|true damage}} but the buff will still be consumed. ** It does not deactivate against the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}. * {{tip|Shield|Shields}} will take priority over ''Void Shift'', but the buff is always consumed, even if the shield fully mitigates the damage. {{bug}} ** However, if '''Malzahar''' has a {{tip|spell shield}} and is hit by an effect that isn't negated by the ''spell shield'', then if the {{tip|shield}} fully mitigates the damage, ''Void Shift'' will not be consumed. * {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} take priority over ''Void Shift'' for abilities that contain a {{tip|crowd control}} effect. * ''Void Shift'' will specifically not deactivate if '''Malzahar''' eats {{ui|Honeyfruit}} or is within a hostile {{ii|Frozen Heart}} passive [[aura]]. {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * ''Void Shift'' does not prevent {{cais|E|Zoe}} trap {{tip|drowsy}}. |champion     = Malzahar
|skill        = R

He then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target and dealing them {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself in the process.

|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} for the {{tip|tether}}, and {{tip|persistent area damage}} additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage|indirect}} to enemies within the ''Null Zone''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents both the tether and the ''Null Zone'' from appearing, however '''Malzahar''' will continue to ''channel''. [https://www.reddit.com/r/Sivir/comments/g7yt38/if_you_shield_malzahar_ult_he_ironically_gets_ccd/]
* The tether will not break if the target enters a {{tip|zombie state}} or enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* As long as the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over {{fd|2.5}} seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.{{bug}}
** This occurs regardless of how the tether was broken.
** If the target exits tether range they will stop taking damage, but can be damaged again by the remaining ticks if they re-enter the tether range within the duration.
* Removing the {{tip|suppression}} will also remove the {{tip|true sight|reveal}}.
* '''Malzahar''' places himself onto the ground and interrupts {{tip|airborne|displacements}} affecting him upon starting the ''channel''.
* If a target is currently being affected by ''{{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}'', casting ''Nether Grasp'' on them will grant 2 stacks toward effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}.{{bug}}
** This is, correctly, not the case if ''Nether Grasp'' is cast before ''Malefic Visions''.
